name: lightboard
blurb: Text scrolls across a grid of circular lights; stops when hovered and can be drawn on.
description: Renders text as animated dots on a canvas-based LED-style light board. Text scrolls continuously until hover pauses it. Supports optional freehand drawing on the lights when enabled.
use_when: Retro or playful interactive displays, event installations, or decorative text that benefits from a LED board aesthetic.
avoid_when: Screen-reader-dependent users — text rendered to canvas is not semantically accessible.
a11y: Text is canvas-rendered and not announced. No keyboard interaction or focus management.
